blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) on Monday lauded the peaceful conduct of rallies commemorating the 54th anniversary of Martial Law, crediting cops and organizers for maintaining order while respecting protesters’ constitutional right to assembly. More than 17,000 police officers have been deployed since Saturday night as multisectoral groups took to the streets across Metro Manila to commemorate the dark chapter in Philippine history. Monday’s demonstrations also marked the second year of the “Trillion Peso March,” which emerged last year amid a multibillion-peso corruption controversy surrounding flood control projects.
